scopeTemplate.notes: Authorized, passive-only observation of the declared target: configured scans and observed responses. Anything beyond reading public responses stops here and needs a new written scope.
boundaries: No interaction beyond the configured passive scan traffic.
No credentials, no authenticated areas, no form submissions.
Stop and report on unexpected personal data instead of collecting it.
Target substitutions need a fresh written declaration.

checklist.item: Written authorization for this exact target is on file and in date.
The configured target URL matches the declared target exactly.
Record observed status, headers, and redirect chain as evidence.
Confirm no credentials or session tokens were sent or stored.
Note anything out of scope encountered and halt that line of inquiry.
File the evidence pack with timestamps before closing the session.
